verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's own privacy docs describe an EU Data Residency Program that lets customers process and store personal data in Europe, so a first-party residency choice exists. The evidence shows only a single EU option and does not explain how a project selects or switches regions. missing for 10: documentation of the region-selection mechanism (per project, at signup, migration), any regions beyond the EU, scope of what data stays in-region, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Mixpanel provides you with the option to process and store your customers' personal data in Europe via our EU Data Residency Program.
